import sys,pathlib,json,hashlib,re,collections,time
root=pathlib.Path('/var/projects/toy_physics/research/pde_ledger_v3');sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'_measurements'));sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
from S11c_d_joint_sheet_check import engine,_restore
from S11c_d_joint_sheet_inventory import association
from S11c_d_output_codec import decoded_lines
start=time.monotonic();base=pathlib.Path('/tmp/s11cd-threshold-20260911');full=base/'full/full.out'
r=json.loads((root/'_measurements/S11c_d_threshold_full_modes_inventory.json').read_text())['results'][0]
records=r['records'];censuses={k:v for k,v in records.items() if k.endswith(('_RIGHT_CENSUS','_LEFT_CENSUS'))}
disks={k:v for k,v in records.items() if k.endswith('_EXCEPTION_DISK_DOMAIN')}
connections={k:v for k,v in records.items() if k.endswith('_CONNECTION_SUMMARY')}
point_summaries={k:v for k,v in records.items() if re.search(r'_TARGET_\d+_ROOT_\d+_LIFT_\d+_SUMMARY$',k)}
ranks={k:v for k,v in records.items() if k.endswith('_RANK_DOMAIN')}
issues={k:v for k,v in records.items() if isinstance(v,dict) and v.get('DEFINED') is False}
exact_counts=collections.Counter();nonzero=[];loop_residuals=[]
for line in decoded_lines(full):
 tag,_,payload=line.rstrip('\n').partition(': ')
 if not tag.startswith('PY_S11CD_THRESHOLD_MODE_'):continue
 category=None
 for name,pattern in [('chainEquation',r'_CHAIN_\d+_EQUATION_RESIDUAL_\d+$'),('planeEquation',r'_PLANE_EQUATION_RESIDUAL_\d+$'),('blockKernel',r'_UNIT_FRAME_\d+_RESIDUAL$'),('radicalTaylor',r'_RADICAL_TAYLOR_RESIDUAL_\d+$'),('determinantChainMultiplicity',r'_DETERMINANT_CHAIN_MULTIPLICITY_RESIDUAL$')]:
  if re.search(pattern,tag):category=name;break
 if category:
  exact_counts[category+'Objects']+=1
  for path,value in engine.leaves(_restore(payload)):
   if isinstance(value,engine.sp.core.symbol.Str):continue
   exact_counts[category+'Scalars']+=1
   if value!=0:nonzero.append({'tag':tag,'path':str(path),'value':str(value)})
 if '_LOOP_' in tag and tag.endswith('_NORMAL_PATH'):
  a=association(_restore(payload));loop_residuals.append({'tag':tag,'endPlusSeedAbsolute':abs(complex(a['END_Q']+a['SEED_Q']))})
result={'transcript':str(full),'sha256':r['sha256'],'counts':r['counts'],'pointCount':len(point_summaries),
 'completePointCount':sum(v['CHAINS_COMPLETE'] for v in point_summaries.values()),
 'chainCensusCount':len(censuses),'stabilizedCensusCount':sum(v['STABILIZED'] for v in censuses.values()),
 'kernelCountPatterns':dict(collections.Counter(str(v['KERNEL_COUNTS']) for v in censuses.values())),
 'kernelBasisRankPatterns':dict(collections.Counter(str(v['KERNEL_BASIS_RANKS']) for v in censuses.values())),
 'chainLengthsRight':dict(collections.Counter(str(v['RIGHT_LENGTHS']) for v in point_summaries.values())),
 'chainLengthsLeft':dict(collections.Counter(str(v['LEFT_LENGTHS']) for v in point_summaries.values())),
 'rankNullityResidualPatterns':dict(collections.Counter(str(v['RANK_NULLITY_RESIDUALS']) for v in censuses.values())),
 'leadingBasisRankCounts':dict(collections.Counter(str(v['LEADING_BASIS_RANK']) for v in censuses.values())),
 'nodeRankNullityCounts':dict(collections.Counter(str((v['RANK'],v['NULLITY'])) for v in ranks.values())),
 'diskCount':len(disks),'definedDiskCount':sum(v['DEFINED'] for v in disks.values()),'diskConditionCounts':dict(collections.Counter(str(v['CONDITION_COUNT']) for v in disks.values())),
 'connectionCount':len(connections),'definedConnectionCount':sum(v['DEFINED'] for v in connections.values()),
 'explicitUndefinedRecords':issues,'exactResidualCounts':dict(exact_counts),'nonzeroExactResiduals':nonzero,
 'loopCount':len(loop_residuals),'normalLoopExchangeResidualMaximum':max((v['endPlusSeedAbsolute'] for v in loop_residuals),default=None),'normalLoopResidualDimensionLTM':[-1,0,0],
 'sourceIndexChecks':r['sourceIndexChecks'],'inventoryIntegrity':{k:r[k] for k in ('duplicates','metadataGaps','nonfiniteObjects','unmatchedObjects')},
 'instrumentSha256':hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'instrumentSource':pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text(),'wallSeconds':time.monotonic()-start}
out=root/'_measurements/S11c_d_threshold_full_summary.json';out.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ('instrumentSource','explicitUndefinedRecords')}))
print('Undefined status counts:',dict(collections.Counter(v.get('STATUS','UNNAMED') for v in issues.values())))
